messages:
Jordan Lee: Proposal: set short "ownership leases" for postmortem followups to avoid stale items. Default 7d for P1, 14d for P2. owner posts a 48h micro-update.

Mira Patel: +1. Can we require a one-line success metric on the followup? avoids vague closures.

Owen Brooks: Agree. Also add a tiny handoff capsule when owner changes: who/from/to/date/remaining (<=3 bullets).

Jordan Lee: example handoff capsule: ```handoff: from:@old to:@new date:2026-04-01 remaining:- add tests - deploy canary - monitor blockers: none success_metric: error_rate<0.05%```

Mira Patel: For recurrence detection, run a T+21d micro-scan: stack fingerprint + metric shape + endpoint match. if >=2 signals match, create candidate and ping owners.

pagerbot: Followup created -> FOL-1201 (owner: Jordan Lee). Lease 7d. 48h reminder scheduled.

Owen Brooks: For comms cadence: during incident use 30m until mitigated; then lease lifecycle with 48h updates. update template: What changed / Next action / ETA / Metric delta.

Jordan Lee: automation: slash command `/followup new --lease=7d --owner=@IC --done_if='error_rate<0.05%'` to create epic with fields owner, lease_days, done_if, owner_history. bot should pin epic link in thread.

Mira Patel: small governance: if owner changes >2x flag for process review. track owner churn in weekly digest.

Owen Brooks: I'll prototype the bot timers. Jordan, can you add the handoff snippet to the runbook?

Jordan Lee: will do PR today. start a 2-incident pilot next week?

Mira Patel: +1 to pilot.

pagerbot: Reminder scheduled: 48h lease-check for FOL-1201 (owner: Jordan Lee).
